verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an Admin API, CLI and MCP server for managing flags, segments and environments, but nothing describes a bulk operation capability such as multi-select editing, batch endpoints or applying one change across many flags at once. Segment overrides and release pipelines are targeting and rollout features, not bulk item operations, and API/CLI access is only a building block for scripting bulk changes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
